notes.title: Beta 1.5 available - Test the potions update!
notes.notes: The 1.5 update is now available in beta for anyone who owns the game. This feature update adds new potions which give the player an array of special abilities! Also in the update is a revamped menu layout with full controller support as well as a selection of bug fixes and performance improvements. To try out the beta simply right click the game in your library, choose properties then the beta tab. Select the beta from the drop down list to opt in. If you do try out the beta do please leave some feedback! Many thanks, and happy clambering...

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1921 Released
notes.notes: This is a small patch that addresses user reported crashes which can happen in some edge cases. It also includes a few tweaks to some maps here and there to improve quality. If you were having issues before please try out this version and let us know your experience! Many thanks, and happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1919 Released
notes.notes: This is a small update which brings the library, xygine, used by Castle Clamber up to date. The latest version addresses the way memory was assigned to sprite animations and shader uniform bindings. Happy Clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1918 for Windows and macOS
notes.notes: This update rolls up some fixes released by the support libraries used by Castle Clamber, generally small improvements in reliability and performance. Happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1917
notes.notes: This is a small release which attempts to address some user reported bugs such as random  crashes around level 20. Be sure to leave any feedback you might have!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1911 Released
notes.notes:
This update is a fairly large overhaul to the game mode, bringing fixes, tweaks and whole new features. The change list includes:

[list]
[*] All new renderer featuring 3D effects and real time lighting
[*] New animations
[*] Improved physics
[*] Many bug fixes and performance improvements incorporated from the latest version of xygine
[*] New steam features such as network play via remote play together and rich presence
[*] Updated game play with added high score challenges and time trial leaderboards
[*] New enemies and bonuses
[*] More achievements
[/list]

Hopefully you'll have fun with the new features, especially the time trial - as always if you have any feedback please comment! Happy Clambering!

notes.title: Version 1.3.1906 now available on the beta branch
notes.notes: We're trying out some new netcode in Castle Clamber, starting with a client side update which should make everything feel a little less laggy. If you want to check it out and offer some feedback, please do! Simply right click on the game in your library, choose Properties and opt into the beta. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.2.1901 Released - multiplayer fixes.
notes.notes: Fresh out of beta this latest version fixes connectivity issues for online multiplayer, for those who were having trouble with the old lobby system. Collision detection has also been tweaked, as well as compatibility testing been carried out with macOS 10.14 Mojave. The main menu now also includes a handy news feed which displays any announcements in a ticker across the bottom of the screen. Don't forget - if you're hosting a game behind NAT and/or a firewall you will need to forward port 27015 to your host computer. Thank you to everyone for their support and patience, and don't forget we love to hear any feedback you have. Happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1811
notes.notes: This small update fixes a few cosmetic issues such as incorrect tiles in some maps on the East Wing, and UI graphics appearing on top of the game ending animation.

notes.title: 1.1.1799 Content Update Released
notes.notes:
This update not only aims to squash bugs and improve stability, but includes a host of new content:

[list]
[*] 3 New Enemies: Swoop the Owl, Doris Poopsnail and Proximity Mines
[*] All new tutorial to introduce the controls and gameplay, available from the main menu
[*] Overhauled maps and graphics, new layout for the West Wing, and new sound effects
[*] Two new achievements: First Steps and Two Can Play That Game
[/list]

Thanks as always goes to everyone who offered feedback and testing, happy clambering!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1357 Now live
notes.notes:
This update brings a few bug fixes, as well as polishes the menu system slightly. Thanks to everyone who offered feedback!

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Killing the Squire while wearing the crown now counts towards the achievement
[*]Player rubber banding has been severely reduced when dropping through the bottom of levels
[*]Dropping non-explosive crates on enemies has a much higher chance of defeating them
[/list]

Menu Improvements:
[list]
[*]UI now has a custom cursor
[*]Help(?) menu button now highlights when the mouse cursor is over it
[*]The help menu now has a button to access the advanced options (which are still available by pressing F1)
[/list]

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: Thanks to everyone who made this a great launch day! I've just released a small update to fix leaderboards potentially hanging in the in-game viewer when selecting 'Friends only' view, bringing the version to 1.0.1325. Thanks for playing, and I look forward to adding new features and polishing any rough edges over the coming months. Happy Clambering!
